Name: Absorbing Shield
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 130, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 467
Description: This +1 heavy steel shield is made of metal, but i ts color is a flat black that seems to absorb light. Once every 2 days, on command, it can disintegrate an object that it touches, as the spell but requiring a melee touch attack. This effect only functions as an attack—it can’t be activated to target a creature or weapon as it strikes the shield.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, disintegrate

Name: Avalanche Shield
Description:
The front of this +1 bashing heavy steel shield looks as though it is crafted from hundreds of bits of rubble and larger stones. When used to make a shield bash attack, stones fall from shield and cling to the target of the shield bash. The target must succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude saving throw or be entangled for 1d4 rounds. Once per day on command, the target’s wielder can choose to petrify the target of a shield bash instead.
The target must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude saving throw or become petrified for 1 minute.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength, shape stone, flesh to stone

Name: Battlement Shield
Description: Once per day on command, this +2 tower shield can transform into a solid, 1-foot-thick, 10-foot-by-10-foot wall of masonry with a battlement on top and an arrow slit in each 5-foot length. The wall acts as cover just like any physical wall. The wielder can touch the wall with one hand and command it to revert to a tower shield either resting on the ground and balanced against his hand or strapped to his arm in the normal fashion. The wall has all the characteristics of any other foot-thick wall of masonry (hardness 8, 90 hit points, break DC 35). Attacks sufficient to destroy the wall cause it to immediately transform back into a shield, which loses half its hit points and gains the broken condition. The shield remains in wall form until destroyed or commanded to return to shield form. The wall cannot appear in a space too small to accommodate it.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, wall of stone

Name: Belligerent Shield
Description: This +1 animated bashing heavy steel shield rattles in anticipation during battle. When loosed into the air to defend its wearer, the belligerent shield attacks as well as defends. Each round starting the round after animation, the shield makes a single shield bash attack against a foe of its wearer’s choice within the wearer’s reach. This works as a standard shield bash attack using the wearer’s normal attack bonus with the shield, except that the wearer retains the shield bonus to AC, and while the shield’s attack is treated as an off-hand attack, the wearer does not take off-hand penalties on her own attacks unless she is fighting with two weapons herself. If the wearer has any feats or abilities that benefit shield bashing attacks, they apply to attacks made by the belligerent shield.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull's strength, animate objects

Name: Bloodfeast Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is rimmed with jagged spikes that drip with dark ichor when blood is spilled nearby. Whenever the wielder confirms a critical hit with a shield bash, the shield absorbs some of the spilled blood and grants the wielder 1d6 temporary hit points that last for 1 minute.

Once per day on command, the wielder can cause the shield to thirst for blood for 9 rounds. During this time, each successful shield bash deals an additional 2d6 points of damage.

This effect is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, vampiric touch

Name: Broadside Bulwark
Description:
This +2 heavy steel shield bears carvings of cannon muzzles along its rim. Three times per day on command, the shield can unleash a thunderous blast in a 30-foot line that deals 6d6 points of bludgeoning damage (Reflex DC 17 half).

Once per day on command, the wielder can create a deafening boom in a 20-foot-radius burst. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude save or be deafened for 1 minute.

The save DCs are Constitution-based.

These effects are CL 12th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shout

Name: Bronze Whisperer's Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is cast from dull bronze and etched with countless tiny runes. The wielder gains a +4 competence bonus on Perception checks.

Three times per day on command, the shield can whisper warnings to its wielder, granting a +2 insight bonus to AC for 1 round.

Once per day on command, the wielder can gain the benefits of clairaudience/clairvoyance.

Clairaudience/clairvoyance is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, clairaudience/clairvoyance

Name: Burglar's Buckler
Description:
This +1 buckler is fitted with concealed tools and hidden compartments. The wielder gains a +4 competence bonus on Disable Device checks.

Three times per day on command, the wielder can gain the benefits of knock.

Knock is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, knock

Name: Caster's Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is etched with arcane sigils. The wielder gains a +4 competence bonus on concentration checks.

Three times per day on command, the shield can absorb a spell that targets the wielder, as if using dispel magic against that spell (caster level 7th).

Once per day on command, the wielder can gain the benefits of shield.

Shield and dispel magic are CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dispel magic, shield

Name: Celestial Shield
Description:
This +2 heavy steel shield shines with a soft golden glow. The wielder gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against evil spells and spell-like abilities.

Three times per day on command, the shield can emit a 20-foot-radius burst of holy light that deals 5d6 points of damage to evil creatures (Will DC 17 half).

Once per day on command, the wielder can gain the benefits of holy smite.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

These effects are CL 12th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, holy smite

Name: Celestial Shield
Description:
This +2 heavy steel shield shines with a soft golden glow. The wielder gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against evil spells and spell-like abilities.

Three times per day on command, the shield can emit a 20-foot-radius burst of holy light that deals 5d6 points of damage to evil creatures (Will DC 17 half).

Once per day on command, the wielder can gain the benefits of holy smite.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

These effects are CL 12th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, holy smite

Name: Clawhand Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is shaped like a monstrous claw. When used to make a shield bash, it deals damage as though it were one size category larger.

Three times per day on command, the wielder can cause the claw to animate for 9 rounds. During this time, the wielder gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to grapple, and a successful shield bash allows the wielder to attempt a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity.

This effect is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength

Name: Collapsible Tower
Description:
This +1 tower shield is crafted with intricate hinges and reinforced panels. As a standard action on command, the shield can collapse into a compact form that occupies only a 1-foot-square space and weighs 5 pounds. As another standard action, it can expand back into a normal tower shield.

Once per day on command, the shield can create a 10-foot-tall wall of force directly in front of the wielder that lasts for 9 rounds. This wall functions as wall of force and is fixed in place.

Wall of force is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, wall of force

Name: Darkwood Buckler
Description: This masterwork buckler is crafted from darkwood. It functions as a normal buckler but weighs half as much and has no armor check penalty.

Name: Darkwood Shield
Description: This masterwork light wooden shield is crafted from darkwood. It functions as a normal light wooden shield but weighs half as much and has no armor check penalty.

Name: Dragonslayer's Shield
Description:
This +2 heavy steel shield is emblazoned with the image of a slain dragon. The wielder gains fire resistance 20 and a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects created by dragons.

Three times per day on command, the shield can reflect a dragon’s breath weapon back at its source. The wielder must succeed at a Reflex saving throw against the breath weapon; if successful, the breath weapon is reflected back at the dragon and the wielder takes no damage.

This effect is CL 12th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, protection from energy

Name: Driftwood Shield
Description:
This +1 light wooden shield appears to be fashioned from waterlogged driftwood. The wielder gains a swim speed of 20 feet.

Three times per day on command, the shield can transform into a sturdy wooden raft large enough to support up to four Medium creatures. This transformation lasts for 7 minutes, after which the shield returns to its normal form.

This effect is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, water walk

Name: Elephant Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield bears the engraved image of a charging elephant. When the wielder successfully performs a bull rush while using this shield, the target is pushed an additional 5 feet.

Three times per day on command, the wielder can gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength for 9 rounds.

This effect is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength

Name: Elysian Shield
Description:
This +2 heavy steel shield shines with a gentle golden radiance. The wielder gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against evil spells and spell-like abilities.

Three times per day on command, the shield can emit a 20-foot-radius burst of holy light that deals 5d6 points of damage to evil creatures (Will DC 17 half).

Once per day on command, the wielder can gain the benefits of holy smite.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

These effects are CL 12th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, holy smite

Name: Equalizer Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield bears balanced scales upon its face. Whenever the wielder is attacked by a creature with a higher base attack bonus than her own, she gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against that attack.

Three times per day on command, the shield can impose a –2 penalty on a single opponent’s attack rolls for 9 rounds (Will DC 16 negates).

The save DC is Charisma-based.

This effect is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bestow curse

Name: Force Tower
Description:
This +2 tower shield is made of translucent crystal and reinforced with shimmering force effects. Once per day on command, the shield can create a wall of force directly in front of the wielder that lasts for 13 rounds. The wall is 10 feet high and 5 feet wide and is fixed in place.

Wall of force is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, wall of force

Name: Fortress Shield
Description:
This +1 tower shield is engraved with the likeness of a fortress gate. Three times per day on command, the shield can anchor itself to the ground and provide total cover to the wielder for 1 round.

Once per day on command, the shield can create a 5-foot-wide, 5-foot-high stone barrier directly in front of the wielder that lasts for 9 minutes. This barrier functions as wall of stone and is fixed in place.

Wall of stone is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, wall of stone

Name: Guard of Man
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield bears the image of a vigilant guardian. The wielder gains a +2 insight bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity.

Three times per day on command, the shield can grant the wielder the benefits of protection from evil for 9 minutes.

Protection from evil is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, protection from evil

Name: Gunner’s Buckler
Description:
This +1 buckler is fitted with reinforced plating and shock-absorbing padding. The wielder gains a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls made with firearms.

Three times per day on command, the wielder can ignore the misfire chance of a firearm for 1 round.

This effect is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, true strike

Name: Gunner’s Buckler
Description:
This +1 buckler is fitted with reinforced plating and shock-absorbing padding. The wielder gains a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls made with firearms.

Three times per day on command, the wielder can ignore the misfire chance of a firearm for 1 round.

This effect is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, true strike

Name: Lens of the Void
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield has a dark crystalline lens set into its center. The wielder gains a +4 competence bonus on Perception checks made to notice invisible or ethereal creatures.

Three times per day on command, the shield can grant the wielder the benefits of see invisibility for 9 minutes.

See invisibility is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, see invisibility

Name: Lion's Shield
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 136, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 467
Description: This +2 heavy steel shield is fashioned to appear as a roaring lion’s head. Three times per day as a free action, the lion’s head can be commanded to attack (as a lion) any opponent within 5 feet of the shield’s bearer. The lion’s head has a base attack bonus of +15, and it makes one bite attack that deals 1d8+6 points of damage. The lion’s head’s attack is treated as a magic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. The lion’s head can make up to three attacks per day, and no more than one per round.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, summon monster V

Name: Lion-Skull Klar
Description:
This +1 klar is fashioned from a lion’s skull reinforced with steel. When used to make a shield bash, it deals an additional 1d6 points of damage on a successful hit.

Three times per day on command, the wielder can emit a terrifying roar. Creatures within 20 feet must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or be shaken for 1d4 rounds.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

This effect is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cause fear

Name: Lion-Skull Klar
Description:
This +1 klar is fashioned from a lion’s skull reinforced with steel. When used to make a shield bash, it deals an additional 1d6 points of damage on a successful hit.

Three times per day on command, the wielder can emit a terrifying roar. Creatures within 20 feet must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or be shaken for 1d4 rounds.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

This effect is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cause fear

Name: Lockpick Shield
Description:
This +1 buckler contains cleverly concealed tools along its inner rim. The wielder gains a +4 competence bonus on Disable Device checks.

Three times per day on command, the shield can grant the wielder the benefits of knock.

Knock is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, knock

Name: Maelstrom Shield
Description:
This +2 heavy steel shield swirls with patterns resembling crashing waves. The wielder gains a swim speed of 20 feet.

Three times per day on command, the shield can unleash a 30-foot line of rushing water that deals 6d6 points of bludgeoning damage (Reflex DC 17 half).

Once per day on command, the shield can create a vortex of water in a 20-foot-radius burst centered on the wielder. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 18 Reflex save or be knocked prone.

The save DCs are Constitution-based.

These effects are CL 12th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, hydraulic torrent

Name: Maiden's Aegis
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is adorned with a serene female visage. The wielder gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against charm and compulsion effects.

Three times per day on command, the shield can grant the wielder the benefits of sanctuary (DC 16).

The save DC is Charisma-based.

Sanctuary is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, sanctuary

Name: Mithral Heavy Shield
Description: This masterwork heavy steel shield is crafted from mithral. It is treated as a light shield for the purpose of proficiency and reduces its armor check penalty by 3 (to 0). Its arcane spell failure chance is reduced by 10%.

Name: Phalanx Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is emblazoned with a stylized spear and tower. While adjacent to at least one ally also wielding a shield, the wielder gains a +1 shield bonus to AC.

Three times per day on command, the shield can create a defensive stance that grants the wielder a +2 circumstance bonus to AC for 1 round.

This effect is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shield of faith

Name: Poisoner's Buckler
Description:
This +1 buckler contains a concealed reservoir along its rim. The wielder gains a +4 competence bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks made to create poisons.

Three times per day on command, the shield can coat a wielded weapon with a virulent toxin. The next creature struck by that weapon must succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude save or take 1d2 points of Constitution damage.

The save DC is Constitution-based.

This effect is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, poison

Name: Quick Block Buckler
Description:
This +1 buckler is reinforced with flexible steel bands. Three times per day on command, the wielder can gain a +4 shield bonus to AC against a single attack as an immediate action.

Once per day on command, the wielder can gain the benefits of shield for 8 rounds.

Shield is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shield

Name: Shield of Covered Retreat
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield bears the image of a shield wall in orderly withdrawal. The wielder gains a +2 insight bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity provoked by movement.

Three times per day on command, the shield can grant the wielder the benefits of expeditious retreat for 8 rounds.

Expeditious retreat is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, expeditious retreat

Name: Shield of Hags
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is etched with twisted, cackling visages. The wielder gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against curses.

Three times per day on command, the shield can bestow a curse on a creature struck by a shield bash (Will DC 16 negates). The curse functions as bestow curse.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

Bestow curse is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bestow curse

Name: Shield of Hags
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is etched with twisted, cackling visages. The wielder gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against curses.

Three times per day on command, the shield can bestow a curse on a creature struck by a shield bash (Will DC 16 negates). The curse functions as bestow curse.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

Bestow curse is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bestow curse

Name: Shield of the Mazeborn
Description:
This +2 heavy steel shield bears an intricate labyrinth pattern. The wielder gains a +4 competence bonus on Survival checks made to avoid becoming lost.

Three times per day on command, the shield can teleport the wielder up to 30 feet as dimension door.

Once per day on command, the shield can banish a creature struck by a shield bash into an extradimensional maze (Will DC 18 negates). The effect functions as maze and lasts for up to 12 rounds.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

These effects are CL 12th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dimension door, maze

Name: Slaver's Madu
Description:
This +1 madu is fitted with cruel barbs and hooked edges. When the wielder successfully performs a disarm or grapple combat maneuver using the shield, the target takes 1d6 points of damage.

Three times per day on command, the wielder can attempt a trip or disarm combat maneuver as a free action after a successful shield bash.

This effect is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength

Name: Spell Ward Tower Shield
Description:
This +2 tower shield is inscribed with arcane sigils of protection. The wielder gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against spells.

Three times per day on command, the shield can create a spell resistance barrier that grants the wielder spell resistance 21 for 13 rounds.

Once per day on command, the shield can reflect a targeted spell back at its caster as spell turning.

These effects are CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, spell resistance, spell turning

Name: Spellbane Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is etched with counterspelling sigils. The wielder gains a +4 competence bonus on dispel checks made to counterspell.

Three times per day on command, the shield can automatically counter a spell that specifically targets the wielder, as if using dispel magic (caster level 9th).

Dispel magic is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dispel magic

Name: Spined Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is covered in sharp protruding spikes. When used to make a shield bash, it deals an additional 1d6 points of piercing damage.

Three times per day on command, the shield can extend its spines for 8 rounds, increasing the shield’s bash damage by one size category.

This effect is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull’s strength

Name: Spirit Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is etched with faintly glowing runes and seems partially translucent. The wielder gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against incorporeal creatures.

Three times per day on command, the shield can strike incorporeal creatures as though it were a ghost touch weapon for 9 rounds.

This effect is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ghost touch, protection from evil

Name: Tempest Shield
Description:
This +2 heavy steel shield crackles with static and smells faintly of ozone. The wielder gains electricity resistance 20.

Three times per day on command, the shield can unleash a 30-foot line of lightning that deals 6d6 points of electricity damage (Reflex DC 17 half).

Once per day on command, the shield can create a thunderclap in a 20-foot-radius burst centered on the wielder. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude save or be deafened for 1 minute.

The save DCs are Constitution-based.

These effects are CL 12th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, lightning bolt, shout

Name: Volcanic Shield
Description:
This +2 heavy steel shield is etched with molten cracks that glow faintly. The wielder gains fire resistance 20.

Three times per day on command, the shield can unleash a 30-foot line of fire that deals 6d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 17 half).

Once per day on command, the shield can erupt in a 20-foot-radius burst of lava and flame centered on the wielder. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 18 Reflex save or take 8d6 points of fire damage (Reflex half).

The save DCs are Constitution-based.

These effects are CL 12th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fireball, wall of fire

Name: Winged Shield
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 142, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 467
Description: This +1 light wooden shield is often engraved with the image of a bird. Three times per day as a free action, the shield can be loosed to fly and attack a designated target as if animated. The shield attacks with a +5 bonus and deals 1d4+1 points of damage. The shield is considered a magic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. After attacking for up to 5 rounds, the shield returns to the wielder and can be used normally again.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, animate objects

Name: Winged Shield
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 142, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 467
Description: This +1 light wooden shield is often engraved with the image of a bird. Three times per day as a free action, the shield can be loosed to fly and attack a designated target as if animated. The shield attacks with a +5 bonus and deals 1d4+1 points of damage. The shield is considered a magic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. After attacking for up to 5 rounds, the shield returns to the wielder and can be used normally again.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, animate objects

Name: Zombie Skin Shield
Description:
This +1 heavy steel shield is covered in stitched, pallid flesh. The wielder gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against disease and paralysis.

Three times per day on command, the shield can animate the stitched flesh to lash out at a creature within 5 feet, making a melee touch attack that deals 2d6 points of damage and forces the target to succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be staggered for 1 round.

The save DC is Constitution-based.

This effect is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, animate dead
